27. a) Robert A. Anderson 
c) Alderman, City of Milwaukee
d) 115 & 148
e) Stated the Airport Spur or some direct route to the airport should have been built the same time as I-94 was constructed (1966). Asked in what years I-94 and Hamlin-Garland School were constructed. Stated that the on and off ramps, Layton Avenue, 20th, College Avenue and Drexel Avenue are not overloaded. Stated he was against the construction of the spur.
f) A direct route to the airport should g) have been built when the I-94 was originally built.
See the response to Witness 11 on page 236.
Questioned why Grange Avenue was not selected for the Airport Spur.
See page 89 for a response.
Questioned the $24 million cost.
See page 19 for a response.
Questioned the time relationship between the construction of I-94 and Hamlin-Garland School.
The construction of I-94 between S. County Line and Holt Avenue was completed in 1966 while Hamlin-Garland School was built in 1967.
